snippet.title: Agent Skunk: Stink Ops | Official PS5 Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet the multiverse’s sneakiest secret agent -- a skunk on a mission to stop an evil zebra commander and save the multiverse!

Sneak past enemies, hide in bushes, disappear into clouds of smoke, or take opponents by surprise with stealthy takedowns. And when stealth isn’t enough, unleash your skunk’s signature stink attack to neutralize a whole group at once!

Upgrade your jetpack as you progress, going from a double jump to soaring through the air. Use your smoke launcher to stay out of sight, explore different locations, and search for collectibles along the way.

Stealth is your greatest weapon, but you can always stand your ground when things get messy. There’s more than one way to get the job done!

The multiverse is counting on you. Time to show that this little skunk agent is up to the task!
